success.title: Image optimization is available
success.details: Your site is using {plugin_name} for image optimization, which helps reduce image file sizes while maintaining quality if enabled.
steps: Review optimization settings for optimal balance of quality and size
Check if WebP conversion is enabled

error.title: Image optimization plugin is not available
error.details: We don't detect any of our recommended image optimization plugins on your site. While you may be using a different optimization solution that's not in our list, using popular and recommended plugins will help ensure optimal performance and compatibility. If you're using a different solution, make sure it's properly configured for your needs.
steps: Configure optimization settings for your needs
Enable WebP image conversion if possible
We recommend using plugins like ShortPixel, Smush, Imagify, or EWWW Image Optimizer, just to name a few.

learn_more.description: Image optimization reduces file sizes while maintaining visual quality, significantly improving page load times and reducing bandwidth usage.
